context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly Leaderboard feature fully implemented and tested. Key points: 1) GET /api/leaderboard/weekly is PUBLIC (no auth required) - returns top performers by profit. 2) POST /api/bets/log requires auth - logs bet results with proper profit calculation (win: amount_won - amount_wagered, loss: -amount_wagered, push: 0). 3) GET /api/user/betting-stats requires auth - returns this_week, all_time stats and recent_bets. 4) Minimum 3 bets required to qualify for leaderboard. 5) Current week is 2026-W10 (Mar 09-15). 6) Admin user 'hun***' is at rank #1 with profit displayed in green.
